honest_framing: The 31 unmapped classes are NOT directly representable in Perch's fixed eBird output label space (neither exact eBird-code match nor scientific-name fallback succeeds). This is a limit of the fixed output vocabulary, NOT a claim that Perch's acoustic encoder cannot transfer to insects/herps/mammals; the encoder may still carry usable acoustic signal, but it has no eBird-head output unit to express it.
